notes.title: Context Injection And Mace NERF
notes.content:
Mace has been nerfed. (It's A Back Up Weapon)

Beginning enemy types have been nerfed to match. (So mace isn't good mid to late game)

Ammo added in various areas. 

Text added in center by alluring angel. Text added after chest.

Super Mace has been assigned 6 instead of 7.

Weapons 1-6 has been aligned with discovery.
 
Secret Area Text Has Been Reworded. Seems my warning message wasn't clear enough for some odd reason.

Beginning Text has been centered on screen due to people not being able to see it on the bottom. 

Master Sound Volume Added In.  

Story Text Has Been Added In Many Places To Give More Context.

Weapon Names Are Now Presented After You Acquire Them.

Textures/materials changed around and environments look more abstract and crazy now.

notes.title: Quality Of Life Update
notes.content:
Ammo has been added in cave area.
Ammo totals have been increased.
Lore added in second level to explain the clay enemies.
Light added to maze section to show the player where to go.
Meshes moved around to pronounce certain background features.
White enemy has had shots reduced, damaged reduced and cooldown extended. 
Light added in water level to show player where to go in a dark tunnel.

notes.title: Huge Update To Visuals And Progression.
notes.content:
Key system has been dropped in favor of switch system.
Visual overhaul in forgotten ruins.
Secret Area added somewhere.
Tutorial has been shortened even more.
Save reminder text now shows up 3 times and no more. 
Light adjustments in various areas for an even more pleasing look.
Level loading screen updated with new visuals.
Doors replaced with fog walls.
Breadcrumbs added in for guidance in more areas.
Enemies are now more difficult.
New enemy types have been rotated in different areas for a slower reveal.
Very hard is now harder.
Mesh fixes and collisions added.
Time place has had it's end reworked for a better visual appeal. 
Door pressure plates have been removed and will auto open.
Darkside of the moon is now without dwellings.
Navmesh in light area has been pulled back so enemies don't mesh with animation.
Abyss waters now have bluish tint.
Fog has been added in hub areas for a better look.
Player camera has been turned 180 when transferred to the void. 
Serpent only spawns once in the void.

notes.title: Breadcrumbs added to key...
notes.content:
Breadcrumbs added to blue key
Tut level made smaller
Doors now open very quickly due to E key spamming.
Later levels had more walls put up.

notes.title: Collision updated in some areas and more holes patched.

notes.title: Weapon Changes/New Enemy/Sound Equalization
notes.content:
White Orb now has a faster firing rate.
Red Orb now only fires 4 orbs. Amount count to cast 4.
Green Orb now has amount to cast set to 10.
Added waterfall in one of the last stages.
Added a new enemy in one of the last stages.
Every sound has been equalized to 0.5.

notes.title: Gameplay Changes/Cosmetic Readjustments
notes.content:
Green Orb (Shotgun) has been tilted for a more cosmetically pleasing look.
Red Orb (Grenade) now fires 5 Orbs.
Super Mace now fires 4 homing projectiles. 
Green Enemy gets a slight nerf I'd say by roughly 7%. Don't get close to him.
White Enemy shots have been reduced from 8 to 6.
Temple of light has had floor replaced with a new texture.
Abyss section has had color grading reworked in certain area.
More holes have been patched.

notes.title: Correcting
notes.content:
Some mesh corrections and image placements between loading screens.
Lights added in final area.

notes.title: Graphical overall and Help Tips
notes.content:
Put in Press E t o open chest.
Added in help text on how to dash.
Removed black and white filter to make it blue instead cause it hurt peoples eyes?????
Added dynamic lights in near final stage.

notes.title: Video Intro Change
notes.content: Many people think this game is a roguelike for some reason I do not understand. You can save the game at anytime by bringing up the menu.

notes.content: Just patching up some holes that some users found! I didn't catch them all :(.
